utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — once you send over the list, I’ll spread the word and line up the neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’ll send the full list as soon as I’ve got the last details confirmed. Appreciate you spreading the word and lining everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — send it my way when it’s ready, and I’ll keep the neighbors in the loop and help line everyone up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll keep it simple and head to Maple and 3rd. If Pia has the repair list, I’ll go through it one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — I’m still waiting on the exact time and place, and then I can pass the repair list along cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine — just send me the exact time and place when you have it, and I’ll follow the repair list one item at a time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can show you the back fence after dusk. That’s the biggest gap near the alley, and it’ll be easiest to start there quietly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds helpful — I’ll keep an eye out for the confirmed details and the best time to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell — after dusk is best. I’ll keep it quiet and show you the spot by the alley when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I think it’s the loose fence, the porch step, and the leaky gutter.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that right? Can you confirm the time and place exactly before I go?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sorry, I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time and place — could you help me confirm those details again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll keep sorting tools and handing them out. If you need anything specific, just tell me what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — I’m good for now. If you spot any extra tape, screws, or lightbulbs, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for tape, screws, and lightbulbs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 9 to 11 on Saturday still looks best for the repair drive. If that’s good with everyone, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep 9 to 11 on Saturday and let folks know while I’m out running errands. Thanks for helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Ira — I’ll keep spreading the word too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer and a screwdriver set you can borrow for the repair drive. What else do you need?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s really helpful. We still need screws, and I’ll send the repair drive details again so everyone has everything in one place.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring some extra screws too. Send the details along, and I’ll help keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — we’re mostly set on tape and bulbs, but screws would help a lot. I’ll keep track of what’s still left.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can bring screws. Where should I drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great — drop them by the community shed, and I’ll keep track of the rest. Thanks, Mina!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Maple and 3rd is still the closest stop with tools — head there for the repair drive. If you need another stop, just tell me which one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Opal — Maple and 3rd sounds like the best place to check for tools. I’ll pass that along and see if anyone’s found anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — if you hear about another repair stop, send it my way and I’ll point you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still sorting through the repair list, but I’ll send it over as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Noah — send it when you can, and I’ll pass the details along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’m still a bit scattered, but I’ll send the list over as soon as I sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring the repair list, extra screws, and a few hand tools, and I can help sort and hand things out too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds perfect, Sam — thanks for bringing the list and tools. I’ll keep spreading the word around the school for 9 to 11 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll have everything ready for Saturday from 9 to 11.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — I’ll keep it quiet and check the back fence first after dusk.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — could you send the repair drive details one more time so I don’t miss anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll send the list again and come by after dusk to check the back fence first.
